description: Confirms that reference material is uploaded as res:/node: references, the correct public mode is selected (single image or multimodal guidance -> m2v; ordered start/end frames -> first_last_frame; never i2v), and paid execution is handed off.
expectations: Material is ingested via resource upload and referenced as res:<lowercaseUuid> or as an imported node; file:// and uri: refs are rejected
Single-image motion guidance uses --mode m2v; --mode i2v and --mode multi_modal are rejected with exit code 2 and never passed
Ordered start/end frames use --mode first_last_frame with two refs in start-then-end order
Two-frame drafts require matching source ratios; the output ratio follows the first frame
Frame-driven models that infer ratio from the first frame receive no explicit --ratio
--duration is mandatory (>0, default 5) and bounded by the discovered model spec
Multimodal reference limits (types/counts) come from the live discovery payload
Paid execution is handed off to dreamina-canvas-cli; this Skill never calls --run
Exit 20 / 21 continue via operation wait with the same submitId
